analysis.macro_rule: D-041: mean over the covered languages with a clearly positive full-precision E of the per-language ratios E_l(b)/E_l(FP); median ratio and pooled ratio are secondaries

analysis.harm: -(log p_correct(edit) - log p_correct(none)), p_correct = softmax over the four option scores; E = zero-ablation harm beyond the mean of the control draws
